notes.teaser: Read this if today was heavy.
notes.body: Whoever you are, you made it here. Sit for a minute. You're doing better than you think.
Say salaam to Rashid uncle. He has worked this gate for 22 years.
Library left, cafeteria right, and the best samosas are behind the admin block.
Corner table by the window has a plug that works. Sleep. Seriously.
Someone left a poem in the old poetry section in 2019. It's still there.

notes.teaser: The chai guy knows my order.
notes.body: Doodh patti, less sugar, extra elaichi. Tell him Bilal sent you.
The bench facing west. Thank me later.

stops.body: Welcome! Three stops, one campus. Read the clue, then follow it.
stops.clue: Start at the gate where everyone says salaam.

stops.body: Every book in here was read by someone before you.
stops.clue: Where it's quietest, and the plugs are rare.

stops.body: You made it. The chai is on us; show this to the stall.

relays.teaser: Pass it on: the travelling notebook.
relays.body: Carry this a kilometre and leave it somewhere you love.
